brief: The 6-tool no-code stack that runs my $30K/mo business.

slots.title: Notion HQ
slots.body: Everything lives here. I run SOPs, content calendars, and client portals in one workspace. It’s basically my second brain.

slots.title: Airtable Brain
slots.body: My entire CRM and inventory sit in Airtable. I link records so nothing falls through the cracks. It’s a spreadsheet with superpowers.

slots.title: Webflow Store
slots.body: I built my site without touching code. Webflow handles hosting, SEO, and design tweaks in minutes. It looks custom without the dev bill.

slots.title: Make Automations
slots.body: Make connects every app while I sleep. Leads flow from form to email to CRM automatically. Zero manual data entry, zero headaches.

slots.title: Stripe Checkout
slots.body: Payments are one-click and global. Stripe powers subscriptions, invoices, and instant payouts. I get paid before I even finish my coffee.

slots.title: ConvertKit Emails
slots.body: Newsletters and sequences run on autopilot. I tag subscribers based on behavior and send targeted offers. It’s my 24/7 sales rep.

slots.headline: Build Your $30K Stack
slots.body: Steal these six tools and start scaling. Your no-code empire is one click away.
